title: SpeakPay：针对低资源尼泊尔语金融语音识别的领域自适应LoRA微调Whisper
summary: SpeakPay提出语音优先的数字钱包，通过LoRA微调Whisper large-v2实现尼泊尔语金融语音识别。引入403条话语的NepFinSpeech-403数据集，将词错误率从129.95%降至42.58%，数字识别准确率从0%提升至73.9%，交易成功率提升20倍。仅需100条数据即可减半WER，系统已部署为公开Web应用。
summary_en: SpeakPay presents a voice-first digital wallet using LoRA fine-tuning of Whisper for Nepali financial speech recognition. With a 403-utterance dataset, WER drops from 129.95% to 42.58%, numeral accuracy from 0% to 73.9%, and transaction success improves 20x. Only 100 examples halve WER. Deployed as a public web app.
